description: DirMO-24 feat30 (team recipe, mean of seeds 42/1/2, 4x loss weight on observed speed >= 550 km/s) on the team raw-only df, with leads 1-12 taken from a second block-0 model trained on the change from the latest observed speed (target y - v_lag0, same inputs and weights). Inputs filled causally (observations last value, images <= 24 h, ENLIL none); targets never filled (masked loss). Lab check (jsy301 round RD, pre-registered gate, 5 windows 2023-07..2025-12 on the same df, raw truth, 3 seeds): all leads -1.42 % vs the 4x model [CI -2.48, -0.48], leads 1-12 -14.8 %, high-speed windows -0.52 %, quiet windows -1.96 %, no window worse, bias change < 0.3 km/s. Not chosen by any board number.

data.gap_fill: inputs causal last value (observations unlimited, images <= 24 h, ENLIL none); y never filled
data.time_convention: newest input of origin O is the hour labelled O-1h; lead h target is hour O+h
data.training_rows: df fit_F1/fit_F2/fit_F3 (origin + 144 h <= cutoff), hourly origins

hyperparameters.base_score: block mean of the observed training targets (scalar)

loss_weight.rule: 4 if observed y >= 550 km/s else 1; 0 on missing y; mean 1 per lead over observed rows

short_leads.note: block-0 model on y - v_lag0 (same inputs, 4x@550 on the speed); its leads 1-12 replace the main
